messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase (Tamil) | Back‑Translation (Eng.) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|------------------------------|--------------------------|--------| | Ed | discourse marker “and” | **மற்றும்** | “and” | OK | | ecco, | exclamatory pointer “lo!” | **இதோ!** | “here it is!” | OK | | quasi | degree adverb “almost” | **சுமார்** | “almost” | OK | | al | preposition + article “to the” (introduces dative) | **தொடக்கத்திற்கு** | “to the beginning” | OK | | cominciar | noun “beginning” | **தொடக்கத்திற்கு** | “to the beginning” | OK | | de | genitive “of” | **பாதையின்** | “of the path” | OK | | l'erta, | noun “the steep” (the steep path) | **சாய்ந்த** | “steep” | OK | | una | indefinite article “a” | **ஒரு** | “a” | OK | | lonza | noun “she‑leopard” | **பெண் புலி** | “female leopard” | OK | | leggera | adjective “light” | **இலகுவாகவும்** | “light‑ly and …” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” (links adjectives) | — (conjunction expressed by the suffix **‑வும்** on the adjectives) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | presta | adjective “nimble / swift” | **வேகமாகவும்** | “swift‑ly and …” | OK | | molto, | intensifier “very” | **மிகவும்** | “very” | OK | | che | relative pronoun “which / that” | **அது** | “that” | OK | | di | preposition “with / of” (introduces attribute) | **கூடிய** | “having” | OK | | pel | noun “coat / fur” | **தோலால்** | “by the coat” | OK | | macolato | adjective “spotted” | **புள்ளிகளுடன்** | “with spots” | OK | | era | auxiliary verb “was” (imperfect) | **இருந்தது** | “was” | OK | | coverta; | past participle “covered” (passive) | **மூடப்பட்ட** | “covered” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: **e** – Tamil does not need an explicit coordinating conjunction between the two adjectival predicates; the suffix **‑வும்** on each adjective already conveys the “and” relationship. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected in the current translation.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Tamil script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 31: - Original: மற்றும் இதோ! சாய்ந்த பாதையின் தொடக்கத்திற்கு சுமார், - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 32: - Original: ஒரு பெண் புலி இலகுவாகவும் மிகவும் வேகமாகவும், - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 33: - Original: அது புள்ளிகளுடன் கூடிய தோலால் மூடப்பட்டிருந்தது; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
``` மற்றும் இதோ! சாய்ந்த பாதையின் தொடக்கத்திற்கு சுமார், ஒரு பெண் புலி இலகுவாகவும் மிகவும் வேகமாகவும், அது புள்ளிகளுடன் கூடிய தோலால் மூடப்பட்டிருந்தது; ```
